Moving Beyond the Ledger
We have accepted the language and laws of political
economy. But these laws conceal the true trauma of
production.
What happens to the human essence when life-activity is
reduced to a mere means of physical survival? Production
does not just create goods; it creates the worker as a mentall
and physically dehumanized commodity.

The Prostitution of Human Need
The Creation of Dependency
Every person speculates on creating a new need in another
to force them into a new dependency. The industrialist acts
as a pimp, stimulating morbid appetites to sneak a favor
and extract cash.
The Reduction of the Worker
The worker is reduced to an absolute absence of need.
Light, fresh air, and animal cleanliness cease to be needs. The
treadmill and the filthy cellar become their natural habitat.
Political economy is the science of asceticism.

The Riddle of History Solved
Communism is the positive transcendence of private property.
It is not the abolition of wealth in favor of crude, unnatural poverty,
but the real appropriation of the human essence by and for man.
Key Insight: It is the complete return of man to himself as a social being. This fully
developed naturalism equals humanism, and fully developed humanism equals naturalism.
"It is the true resurrection of nature the consistent naturalism
of man and the consistent humanism of nature."
